name: Requirements (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Requirements capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: the Stakeholder/Analyst roles, work products, and tasks for eliciting, detailing, and reviewing requirements.

capabilities.name: Requirements Management
capabilities.description: Elicits, details, and maintains traceable requirements on behalf of Stakeholders (OpenUP Analyst/Stakeholder roles).

checklists.name: Requirements (OpenUP Capability Pattern) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for OpenUP requirements elicitation, specification, and stakeholder sign-off.

items.statement: Stakeholder needs and constraints have been elicited and outlined as candidate requirements.
Candidate requirements have been elaborated to a level Development and Test can act on.
Dependencies and traceability between requirements, and from requirements to downstream work, are recorded.

reviewGates.name: Requirements Specification Review
reviewGates.statement: The Requirements Specification has been reviewed and accepted by its Stakeholder(s).
reviewGates.prompt: Do the requirements reflect what the Stakeholder actually needs, and are they approved?

obligationDefinitions.title: A changed requirement must be re-confirmed with the stakeholder who originally signed it off
obligationDefinitions.description: OpenUP's Requirements discipline ties each requirement to stakeholder agreement; when a requirement changes after that agreement, the original sign-off no longer covers the new version and must be re-confirmed, not silently carried forward.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every changed requirement has a re-confirmed stakeholder sign-off before it's treated as agreed.

requiredEvidence.title: Requirement re-signoff record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of stakeholder re-confirmation for each changed requirement.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has the stakeholder re-confirmed sign-off for this changed requirement?
